tools.name: create_doc
tools.description:
Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text
        are stored unchanged. Returns ok=true and the stored document, including
        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

# Evergreen — April 16, 2026 Admin Review Closeout

**Review date:** April 16, 2026  
**Record type:** Historical closeout

## Accepted
Evergreen accepted the following as valid current-state review material:
- Shipped SAML login
- Visible invite/source/admin audit lookup
- Workspace-admin support path
- March closed usage read (199 monthly active developers) under standard Growth usage mechanics

## Sync-operator request
Evergreen asked whether granular sync-operator work could be described as an expected Q3 item for its internal admin memo. It was **not accepted as a commitment**. The request remained later advanced-admin research/input with no committed date, package, renewal condition, procurement/security add-on, overage cap, or custom-admin commitment.

## Closeout
